newsitem.title: SPAIN: CYCLING-SPANISH RIDER IN "VERY SERIOUS" CONDITION AFTER CRASH.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-SPANISH RIDER IN "VERY SERIOUS" CONDITION AFTER CRASH.

text.p: Spanish rider Jose Antonio Espinosa was in a "very serious" condition on Sunday after colliding with a race official.
"His situation is very serious...the neurological development is bad," said a doctor at the Clinical Hospital in Madrid.
The accident on Saturday came during the team time-trial section of the Criterium de Fuenlabrada when Espinosa and his MX Onda team mates were travelling at about 50 kph.
Race official Francisco Casillas's condition was described as serious. He suffered facial bone fractures.
